newsitem.title: UK: LME copper barely changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper barely changed in late trading.

text.p: LME copper was little changed in late inter-office trading on Monday evening.
At 1900 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,080/83, compared to $2,181 at the afternoon kerb close.
Support was pegged at the day's low of $2,080, with a breach of that level expected to send prices down to $2,000, chartists said.
The other metals were little changed, with aluminium indicated at $1,514/17 versus $1,516 at the kerb close.
